summary: Verified TRANSPETRO PIX 'Vaga Escolhida' bug fix. Seeded sessionStorage with the exact payload from the request (VAGA cargo name + __vaga_label containing cargo+edital+ANEXO), navigated directly to /pagamento-pix and /inscricao-realizada. All three test cases PASS: (1) #p-vaga on /pagamento-pix shows ONLY 'ÊNFASE 4: DUTOS E TERMINAIS' (no TRANSPETRO/PSP, no ANEXO III, no 2026.3); (2) #p-valor = 'R$ 81,50' and BRCode/copia-e-cola generated with '5405 81.50'; (3) /inscricao-realizada shows Cargo Escolhido = 'ÊNFASE 4: DUTOS E TERMINAIS' with Status PENDENTE DE PAGAMENTO. Consistent between both pages. Code check: pagamento-pix.html line 266 uses `d.VAGA || d.__cargo_titulo || d.__vaga_label` — correct precedence.
critical_code_review_comments: pagamento-pix.html falls back to __vaga_label if VAGA/__cargo_titulo missing — for legacy sessions this could still display the long label. Consider dropping __vaga_label fallback entirely to be safe.
seed_data_creation: sessionStorage['inscricao_dados'] seeded with VAGA + __vaga_label to validate the fix in isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix on #p-vaga confirmed via direct sessionStorage seeding on preview URL. QR/BRCode contains '81.50'. Both /pagamento-pix and /inscricao-realizada now show identical cargo name.
rca of the issue: Previously #p-vaga was populated with d.__vaga_label (cargo + edital + anexo). Fix: use d.VAGA which stores only the cargo/ênfase name — matches /inscricao-realizada #r-vaga.
